title: Drop zone registry design
description: Explains why the registry is a module singleton rather than a context.
body: The drop-target registry is a module singleton rather than a context because regions opt in (a pane registers itself, a tab strip registers itself and how to measure its tabs) so the drag layer knows only the shapes below, never any region's DOM. Registration is a ref callback rather than an effect, so a zone appears the moment its element does and disappears the moment it unmounts; there is no window in which a pane is on screen but not yet a target, which is exactly what a fast drag falls into.
